coins_latest.name: Just a hype guy
coins_latest.description: I know I’m supposed to be a hype guy, always loud, always excited, always convinced something incredible is about to happen. Truth is, I get nervous too. I just keep thinking about all the good things we’ll never get to see if everybody’s too embarrassed to try. Think about that thing you can’t shut up about when you’re around the right people. The idea that keeps you awake. The version of yourself you keep saving for “one day.” Give that person a chance. Make the thing. Be bad at it for a while. Let people see how much you care. And when your friend finally takes their shot, show up. Listen to their first song. Try the thing they built. Celebrate that tiny win they almost didn’t tell anyone about. Sometimes one person getting excited is enough to make somebody try again. There will be days when nothing works and nobody claps. Keep a little excitement for those days too. You’re still learning. You’re still becoming someone you haven’t met yet. So yeah, I’m a hype guy. I care too much. I clap too loud. And if you’re finally doing that thing you’ve always wanted to do, I’m already in your corner. Go give me something to cheer for.
